name: find_patient
description: Find patients by name. Returns candidates (id, name, birth date). If more than one matches, do not choose: report the candidates and ask which patient is meant.

name: get_hospitalization_risk
description: The service's 12-month estimate, for ONE patient, of a hospital admission not related to pregnancy or childbirth, as a FHIR RiskAssessment. Takes only the patient id (and optionally the as-of date). It cannot be adjusted, re-scored with different inputs, or classified as high/low.

name: get_model_card
description: How the risk model was built: model version, training data, validation metrics.
